data.title: Lanai Islands
data.about:
Explore the tranquillity of living in the heart of a resort-style island. Two private paradise islands emerge from the clean Lagoon waters at the place where waves and sand converge. Exclusive estate houses are placed on finely kept lawns beyond magnificent sandy beaches covered by palm palms and surrounded by thick flora.  

These 7 to 8 Bedroom residences are perfectly integrated with nature and provide a quiet sanctuary. Choose from two stunning mansion styles inspired by the world’s most opulent luxury resorts, enabling you to personalize the look of your house based on your aesthetic tastes. This residence is situated in Majid Al Futtaim’s most exclusive neighborhood in Dubai.
